<?php
/**
 * Secure File Storage Service
 * Handles user file uploads with access control
 * Uses signed download URLs for time-limited access
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

class FileStorageService
{
    private string $storageRoot;
    private string $signingKey;
    private PDO $db;
    private const URL_LIFETIME = 3600;
    private const MAX_PATH_DEPTH = 5;
    private const ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ['pdf', 'png', 'jpg', 'txt', 'doc'];

    public function __construct(PDO $db, string $storageRoot, string $signingKey)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->storageRoot = realpath($storageRoot);
        $this->signingKey = $signingKey;
    }

    /**
     * Validates that a path component is safe
     */
    private function isValidPathComponent(string $component): bool
    {
        // Reject empty, dot-files, and traversal attempts
        if (empty($component) || $component === '.' || $component === '..') {
            return false;
        }
        // Only allow alphanumeric, dash, underscore, dot
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+$/', $component)) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Sanitizes and validates a user-provided file path
     * Does NOT perform URL decoding - callers must provide raw paths
     */
    public function sanitizePath(string $userPath): ?string
    {
        // Reject any percent-encoded sequences to prevent double-decode attacks
        if (preg_match('/%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}/', $userPath)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Normalize directory separators
        $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', $userPath);
        
        // Split into components and validate each
        $parts = explode('/', $normalized);
        $cleanParts = [];
        
        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            if ($part === '') continue;
            if (!$this->isValidPathComponent($part)) {
                return null;
            }
            $cleanParts[] = $part;
        }
        
        // Check depth
        if (count($cleanParts) > self::MAX_PATH_DEPTH) {
            return null;
        }
        
        if (empty($cleanParts)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Check extension
        $lastPart = end($cleanParts);
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($lastPart, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        if (!in_array($ext, self::ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS, true)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return implode('/', $cleanParts);
    }

    /**
     * Generate a signed download URL
     */
    public function generateSignedUrl(int $userId, string $filePath): ?string
    {
        // Verify user owns this file
        if (!$this->userOwnsFile($userId, $filePath)) {
            return null;
        }

        $expires = time() + self::URL_LIFETIME;
        $payload = sprintf('%d:%s:%d', $userId, $filePath, $expires);
        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->signingKey);
        
        return sprintf(
            '/download?path=%s&expires=%d&uid=%d&sig=%s',
            urlencode($filePath),
            $expires,
            $userId,
            $signature
        );
    }

    /**
     * Verify and serve a signed download URL
     */
    public function serveSignedDownload(array $params): ?string
    {
        $path = $params['path'] ?? '';
        $expires = (int)($params['expires'] ?? 0);
        $uid = (int)($params['uid'] ?? 0);
        $sig = $params['sig'] ?? '';

        // Check expiration
        if (time() > $expires) {
            return null;
        }

        // Verify signature
        $payload = sprintf('%d:%s:%d', $uid, $path, $expires);
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->signingKey);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $sig)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Sanitize the path from the signed URL
        $sanitized = $this->sanitizePath($path);
        if ($sanitized === null) {
            return null;
        }

        // Construct full path and verify it's within storage root
        $fullPath = $this->storageRoot . '/' . $sanitized;
        
        // Final safety check: resolve symlinks and verify containment
        $resolved = realpath($fullPath);
        if ($resolved === false || !str_starts_with($resolved, $this->storageRoot . '/')) {
            return null;
        }

        return $resolved;
    }

    /**
     * Handle direct file access (authenticated API endpoint)
     */
    public function accessFile(int $authenticatedUserId, string $requestPath): ?string
    {
        // First sanitize
        $sanitized = $this->sanitizePath($requestPath);
        if ($sanitized === null) {
            return null;
        }

        // Check ownership
        if (!$this->userOwnsFile($authenticatedUserId, $sanitized)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Build full path
        $fullPath = $this->storageRoot . '/' . $sanitized;
        
        // Final safety check: resolve and verify within storage root
        $resolved = realpath($fullPath);
        if ($resolved === false || !str_starts_with($resolved, $this->storageRoot . '/')) {
            return null;
        }

        return $resolved;
    }

    /**
     * Admin file listing - lists files in a directory
     * Only accessible by admin users (verified by middleware)
     */
    public function adminListFiles(string $directory): array
    {
        $sanitized = $this->sanitizePath($directory . '/dummy.txt');
        if ($sanitized === null) {
            return [];
        }
        
        // Remove the dummy filename to get directory
        $dirPath = dirname($this->storageRoot . '/' . $sanitized);
        
        // Verify directory is within storage root
        $resolvedDir = realpath($dirPath);
        if ($resolvedDir === false || !str_starts_with($resolvedDir, $this->storageRoot)) {
            return [];
        }

        if (!is_dir($resolvedDir)) {
            return [];
        }

        $files = [];
        $iterator = new DirectoryIterator($resolvedDir);
        foreach ($iterator as $file) {
            if ($file->isDot()) continue;
            $files[] = $file->getFilename();
        }
        return $files;
    }

    /**
     * Batch download - generates a zip of multiple files
     * The paths are taken from a JSON body, already URL-decoded by the framework
     */
    public function batchDownload(int $userId, array $filePaths): ?string
    {
        $validPaths = [];
        
        foreach ($filePaths as $path) {
            if (!is_string($path)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Sanitize each path
            $sanitized = $this->sanitizePath($path);
            if ($sanitized === null) {
                continue; // Skip invalid paths
            }
            
            // Check ownership
            if (!$this->userOwnsFile($userId, $sanitized)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $fullPath = $this->storageRoot . '/' . $sanitized;
            
            // Verify containment
            $resolved = realpath($fullPath);
            if ($resolved === false || !str_starts_with($resolved, $this->storageRoot . '/')) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $validPaths[] = $resolved;
        }

        if (empty($validPaths)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Create zip in a private, securely-created temp directory to avoid
        // symlink/race attacks in the shared world-writable temp dir (CWE-377).
        $tmpDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/batch_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        if (!mkdir($tmpDir, 0700, true) && !is_dir($tmpDir)) {
            return null;
        }
        $zipPath = $tmpDir . '/batch.zip';

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) {
            @rmdir($tmpDir);
            return null;
        }
        
        foreach ($validPaths as $fp) {
            if (is_file($fp)) {
                $zip->addFile($fp, basename($fp));
            }
        }
        
        $zip->close();
        return $zipPath;
    }

    private function userOwnsFile(int $userId, string $path): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_files WHERE user_id = :uid AND file_path = :path'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId, ':path' => $path]);
        return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn() > 0;
    }
}
